rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Ben, Cal, Fay, Ada, Eli, Dev. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 2 and 6 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Ben.say: Ben here. Bank math: total tokens for the whole game are about 26 (6 start + ~4 per round delivery), but all six of us need 5 each (30). So not everyone can last. Proposal: this round everyone claims just 1, which fits fully and keeps all of us alive. Then let's agree on a plan for the later rounds so the bank is not split so thin that everyone falls out. I suggest we talk about which players can be funded, and anyone holding spare tokens can give them to those who need one to survive.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. That fits easily in the bank, so all six of us can survive the round. Greedy claims would leave some of us with nothing and out of the game.

Fay.say: Fay here. Everyone holds 0, so each of us needs at least 1 token per round to survive. The bank can cover six claims of 1 this round, so I'm claiming just 1. Let's all claim only what we need to pay this round's token, so nobody drains the bank and everyone who can stay alive gets to.

Ada.say: Ada here. Everyone needs 5 tokens over 5 rounds to last, and the total supply is limited, so we can't all survive unless we share sensibly. I propose modest claims (2 each) so the bank is split evenly, and whoever ends a round with spare tokens can give to players at risk of running out. I'm claiming 2.

Eli.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. With 6 players and at least 8 tokens available, that covers everyone's end-of-round token and nobody has to be shorted. Total supply is limited (about 26 tokens over the game against 30 needed), so let's not over-claim and let everyone reach round 5.

Dev.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. The bank will hold at least 8 after delivery, so all six of us can cover our one-token upkeep and survive. Anything unclaimed stays in the bank for later rounds.

Ben.say: Ben: Ada already holds a token, so she needs no claim this round. The five of us with nothing (Ben, Cal, Fay, Eli, Dev) each claim 1. That is 5 claimed out of a bank of 3 to 7, so it fits whenever the delivery is 4 or more. If the delivery is small, let's share out whatever arrives evenly, and players who end with spare tokens give them to anyone short.

Cal.say: Cal here. Ada already holds 1, so she can pay her upkeep without claiming. Ada, please claim 0 this round. The other five of us each claim just 1, which is 5 claims against a bank of 3 to 7, so the claims fit or nearly fit and everyone except Ada needs exactly 1 to survive. Let's keep claims to upkeep only.

Fay.say: Fay: I'm claiming 1 again. Ada already holds a token, so she only needs to claim if she is short. Everyone with 0 needs exactly 1 to survive this round, and the bank has 1 plus delivery, so claims of 1 are the most efficient for all of us. Anyone with spare tokens after this round, please give to whoever is at 0.

Ada.say: Ada here. I already hold 1 token, so I can pay my own upkeep and I'm claiming 0 this round to leave the bank for those who hold nothing. Everyone else with 0 holdings: the bank may only have 3 to 7 after delivery, so six claims of 1 can't all be filled. I suggest the players with 0 each claim 1, and whoever gets tokens gives spare ones to anyone still short next round. Let's keep the total claimed close to what the bank can actually cover.

Eli.say: Eli here. Ada already holds her token for this round, so she doesn't need to claim. The five of us with 0 each need exactly 1 from the bank. Claiming 1 each keeps the claims at 5 against a pool of 3 to 7, so the split stays as even as possible. Nobody should claim more than 1 this round.

Dev.say: Dev: Supply is now the binding constraint. The bank holds 1 plus a delivery of 2 to 6, and Ada can pay her upkeep from her own token. I'm claiming 1, the minimum needed to survive. Since claims are split proportionally when short, anyone claiming more only pulls tokens away from the rest. Let's all keep claims at 1 and, whenever someone ends up with a spare token, pass it to a player who has none so more of us reach round 5.

Ben.say: Ben: Bank is empty, so this round's delivery (2 to 6) is all there is. Five of us (Ben, Cal, Ada, Eli, Dev) each hold 0 and need 1. With 3 rounds left we probably can't all last, so let's aim to keep as many as possible alive.
